objectives.statement: Recognize the meanings and basic uses of og, men, eller, for, and så.
Use coordinating conjunctions to join like elements such as nouns, adjectives, verbs, and short phrases.
Use coordinating conjunctions to join two simple main clauses without changing the basic word order on each side.

notes: Must teach coordinating conjunctions (og, men, eller, for, så) that join main clauses or like elements. Keep word-order explanation minimal; V2 placement and fronting belong to word_order_main_clauses and word_order_subordinate_clauses.
